features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.description:
The Wyrdweaver adds spells to your warlock spell list:

| Spell Level | Spells |
|---|---|
| 1st | bane, faerie fire |
| 2nd | blur, frenzied bolt |
| 3rd | bestow curse, hypnotic pattern |
| 4th | compulsion, reset |
| 5th | battle mind, mislead |

features.name: Probability Wellspring
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you have a pool of probability dice (d6s). Pool size = 1 + warlock level. When you or a friendly creature within 30 ft makes an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, use your reaction to expend up to CHA modifier dice (min 1) and add the total to the roll. Regain all on long rest.

Die size scales: d8 (L5), d10 (L11), d12 (L17).

payload.name: Probability Wellspring
payload.description: Expend probability dice (up to CHA mod) to add to any d20 roll you or an ally within 30 ft makes.

features.name: Appropriate Advantage
features.description: At 1st level, when a creature within 60 ft rolls with advantage, use your reaction to expend one probability die and force a CHA save (DC = your spell save DC + die result). On failure: that creature loses advantage, and one friendly creature within 60 ft gains advantage on their next d20 roll of the same type.

payload.name: Appropriate Advantage
payload.description: When a creature rolls with advantage within 60 ft: spend a probability die, CHA save or it loses advantage and a friendly gains advantage on the next same-type roll.

features.name: Improbable Duplicate
features.description: At 6th level, once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack, expend up to half your CHA modifier (min 1) probability dice and add them to the attack's damage roll.

features.name: Inconceivable Channeling
features.description: At 10th level, when a friendly creature within 30 ft takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, use your reaction to take the damage instead (halved). For every 10 damage prevented, regain one probability die (max half your pool). 1/short or long rest.

payload.name: Inconceivable Channeling
payload.description: Ally within 30 ft takes elemental damage: take it instead (halved). Regain 1 probability die per 10 damage prevented (max half pool).

features.name: Favored Soul
features.description: Starting at 14th level, when a creature within 60 ft rolls with advantage, use your reaction to force a CHA save vs your spell save DC. On failure: it loses advantage and has disadvantage instead; you gain advantage on one d20 roll of your choice within the next minute. 1/short or long rest.

payload.name: Favored Soul
payload.description: Creature within 60 ft rolls with advantage: CHA save or it loses advantage and rolls with disadvantage instead; you gain advantage on one d20 within 1 min.
